verdict.rationale: Fastmail has a first-party 'Offline support' help article. Its one quoted line implies the app works offline and catches up once reconnected (snoozed messages reappear only when back online). But the pack never says what can be done offline, so offline reading, searching, composing and queued-change sync are only implied. Missing for 10: documented offline reading of cached mail, offline search, offline compose/send queueing, explicit sync-on-reconnect behavior, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can read, search, and write email offline, with changes syncing when I reconnect

citations.quote: If you're offline when a snoozed message is scheduled to return to your Inbox, you will not see the snoozed message reappear until you're back online.
